title: Hopeless romantic edition
old_caption: Libra planned the wedding after one coffee and made a playlist called 'us?' version three. Pisces dropped every finger at once over a stranger's proposal. How many did you keep?

title: Texter edition
old_caption: Triple text, typed and deleted, a voice note longer than a song, and 'u in the kitchen?' sent from the next room. Gemini went down to five fingers. How many do you have left?

title: Aries is ready in four seconds
old_caption: Aries got ready in four seconds, at 6 PM, for an 8 PM date. Then re-got ready twelve times and ended up in every outfit at once. Which sign is ready way too early?

title: Cancer rehearses talk card answers to the mirror and cries at their own answer
old_caption: Card one: nailed it. Card two: grandma's soup, and it's definitely the onions. There are no onions. Card three: full fountains, and it was only the practice round. Who else rehearses their answers?

title: Libra can't pick an outfit; holds up two identical shirts
old_caption: Thirty-five minutes, a four-page pros and cons list, and three shirts that are the exact same shirt. Libra, we love you. Which sign takes longest to get ready?

title: Scorpio perfects a mysterious look
old_caption: Scorpio sets the light to moody, puts on the shades, reveals nothing. Also checks the phone 14 times. That was research. Then one text and the whole mystery is gone. Scorpios, how long does yours last?

title: Virgo builds a checklist
old_caption: Virgo's pre-date checklist: mints, charger, backup charger, a backup for the backup, topic one the moon, topic three also the moon, spontaneous laugh at 7:50. The list has a scroll bar.

title: Hear me out: someone who remembers your order
old_caption: Gemini's order has six parts, and they said it back. In order. Then noticed when it changed. Oat milk, extra hot. The front row was not ready. Is remembering your order a green flag?

title: Hear me out: someone who shows up five minutes early
old_caption: Date at 7, there at 6:55, used the time to grab the good table, and texted 'no rush :)'. Capricorn calls that a love language. Then Sag bursts in late, sweating. Which one are you?

title: Hear me out: someone who hates the same song you do
old_caption: Hear me out: Scorpio's crush hates the exact same made-up song. They groaned at it across a party, same pitch. Then it came on again and the whole front row groaned with them.
